title: This Purple-Themed BTS Bag Collection Just Got Restocked for Their ‘Arirang Tour’
summary: The officially-licensed includes backpacks and crossbody bags inspired by the group's signature colorway and motifs.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

ARMY planning their outfits for BTS’s Arirang World Tour this summer now have a few more options, as Loungefly has restocked their BTS collection of bags, backpacks and accessories.

First released to promote the group’s Billboard Hot 100 chart topper , “Dynamite,” the Loungefly x BTS collection sold out quickly after its release, but we’ve spotted the BTS bags back in stock on Amazon, just in time for the group’s North American tour dates .

TOP SELLER

Loungefly BTS Logo Iridescent Purple Mini Backpack

$90

Buy Now ON AMAZON

Inspired by the group’s signature colorway, the collection is designed in a shimmery, purple iridescent shade with intricate illustrations of BTS members RM, SUGA, j-hope, Jung Kook, V, Jimin and Jin on the interior lining.

Fans will also notice other BTS-inspired details such as the group’s logo and silver stars featured across the front of each piece in the collection. This backpack, meantime, features a quilted material with multiple pockets for storage and adjustable shoulder straps.

DAY TO NIGHT OPTION

Loungefly BTS Logo Iridescent Purple Faux Leather Crossbody Bag

The Loungefly x BTS Crossbody Bag features adjustable shoulder straps, silver-colored metal hardware and a metallic chain strap.

Full-color caricatures of all seven members adorns the back of this bag, which is made from a chic, purple-dyed vegan leather. The bag measures 9.5 inches x 6.5 inches.

SELLING FAST

Loungefly Bighit BTS Crossbody Bag

$75

This BTS crossbody dropped last year and it’s almost always sold out, but Amazon still has a few units left.

The bag features an iridescent strap and fold-over flap with a quilted chevron design. The lining features Funko Pop!-inspired illustrations of the BTS members. This bag measures approximately 9 x 7 inches in size.

FAN FAVORITE

Loungefly Bighit BTS Mini Backpack

$75 $78.72 5% off

You can also find the same nude-toned colorway of the above bag in a backpack release.

This backpack measures 9 x 10.5 inches in size, with adjustable iridescent straps and iridescent front flap pocket. There’s plenty of room for a tablet, phone, wallet, notebook, portable fan and other concert or commuting accessories.

All of the above items are officially-licensed merch from BTS, HYBE and Loungefly.

USPECLARE Clear Purse for Stadium Events

Of course, whether you’ll be able to take the BTS bags into the concert depends on the bag rules and regulations for your local venue.

If you want to be safe, Amazon is selling this purple clear bag that’s approved for stadiums and arenas. The clear bag measures 8.3 x 6.7 inches, and lets security easily see what you’re bringing into the concert.

BTS’ Arirang World Tour kicked off on April 9 in Goyang, South Korea and closes its North American run with four shows in Los Angeles in September.
